title: Sternbild Roadmap Pillar
description: One pillar of a project roadmap registry and its features. Each YAML file under the roadmap folder holds one pillar.

prefix.description: Three capital letters that begin the id of every feature in this pillar.

title.description: Pillar name shown in the graph and on the pillar page.

order.description: Display order of the pillar, starting at 1.

summary.description: One or two sentences that describe what the pillar covers.

id.description: Pillar prefix, hyphen, and two or three digits.

title.description: Short name in plain words without a colon.

status.description: shipped: released on the default branch. built: implemented on a branch. planned: scheduled for future work. idea: undecided proposal. decision: open question that blocks dependent features.

scope.description: Role on the product path: core, supporting, or peripheral.

summary.description: One sentence on what the feature does.

depends_on.description: Feature ids that this entry directly requires. Each id forms a graph edge.

sprint.description: Optional sprint label as a positive integer or a point sprint string such as "3.2".

docs.description: Documentation path from the repository root with an optional heading anchor. Required for shipped features.

branches.description: For built work, each branch that holds it, most complete first.

in_progress.description: For built work only: true while the work on its branches is unfinished.

design.description: Design page that proposes the feature, from the repository root, with an optional anchor.

issue.description: Issue number that tracks the feature.

draft.description: True while the dependencies of the entry are a first draft.
